description:
Front-End Developer (Mid-Level) 
 📍 Location: Europe (Work remote)

🕒 Type: Full-Time

💼 Seniority Level: Mid-Level 
 🎯 What You’ll Do 
 As our Front-End Developer, you’ll play a central role in building and optimizing our GenAI-powered video editing platform. You’ll work in a modern monorepo setup, integrating real-time features, browser-level video optimization, and cutting-edge AI interfaces to deliver magical user experiences. 
 GraphQL Integration & Subscriptions: 
 Develop and optimize front-end interfaces leveraging GraphQL queries, mutations, and subscriptions for real-time data fetching and updates. 

 Design robust caching strategies and state synchronization using local storage and state management tools like XState or Zustand. 

 AI & GenAI Integrations: 
 Integrate advanced AI functionalities into applications using Vercel AI SDK and other modern LLM tools. 

 Develop intuitive, chat-driven, and creative AI-powered user experiences. 

 Real-time & Next.js Development: 
 Implement performant, real-time interactions using Next.js, ensuring rapid response times and smooth user experiences. 

 Employ real-time data handling techniques and local caching for improved performance. 

 Media & Video Optimization: 
 Enhance browser-level media and video performance, efficiently managing media metadata, and ensuring seamless playback. 

 Contribute to or develop web-based video editing tools, utilizing frameworks like Remotion. 

 Monorepo Collaboration: 
 Operate effectively within a monorepo environment, managing shared packages and cross-team collaboration. 

 Firebase Integration: 
 Maintain and occasionally optimize existing Firebase services, such as Firestore, Authentication, and Cloud Functions.









🧠 What We’re Looking For 

 

 Proficiency with modern JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Next.js, and GraphQL. 

 Experience implementing GraphQL subscriptions and local storage strategies for optimized performance. 

 Familiarity with integrating advanced AI SDKs, such as Vercel AI SDK, into front-end applications. 

 Strong capability in video performance optimization and media handling. 

 Ability to write clean, maintainable, and modular code. 

 Excellent collaboration skills with a proactive, solution-oriented approach. 

 Passion for innovative products blending creativity with cutting-edge AI technologies. 

 

 🌟 Why Join Us 
 Help invent the future of creative storytelling and interactive video. 

 

 Collaborate in a nimble, mission-driven team backed by a16z. 

 

 Build a meaningful product that delights and inspires kids. 

 

 Take ownership in a startup where your work will directly shape the product. 

 

 Equity, early-stage upside, and creative input from day one.

 Familiarity with integrating advanced AI SDKs, such as Vercel AI SDK, into front-end applications.
